attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his signed Substack tribute; endorsed.

semantics.note: Mostly faithful. The draft makes Cycorp the subject of the 40 years, but Marcus's subject is Cyc with Cycorp in parentheses. The contract fixes this by reading the 40 years as project continuity. Firm, unhedged observation with three parts.

contract.note: The plain reading is fair and ordinary: 40 years taken as project continuity since 1984, with Cycorp as the successor. It is not stretched for or against Marcus. Whether the 40 years holds depends on reading it as project age, not the age of the company.

evidence.note: Lenat's own 2003 abstract puts the project at 1984 and Cycorp's founding at 1994. That backs the project-continuity reading and rules out a literal 40-year corporate age. It is a company disclosure, not an independent finding. Nothing on commercial scale or rarity.
2023 obituary reports work still ongoing when Lenat died. It backs continued operation but says nothing on commercial scale or how many AI firms survive.

reviews.rationale: Continuity of the project since 1984, with work still going on in 2023, has modest support, mostly from company-sourced material. The packet has no evidence on whether Cyc ever reached major commercial scale, and no comparison group showing how rare 40-year survival is. The support condition needs all three parts. Nothing contradicts the claim, but two key parts are unsettled.
